Select molecule ChEMBL ID, name, max phase, type, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL4364343. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, filter by doc_id matching the document, and join compound_structures to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
